name: Pilot
overview: The Scriptures portray pilots as skilled and wise leaders guiding ships and commerce, as seen in Ezekiel's depiction of Tyre where pilots are integral to the city's maritime strength and wealth. However, these verses also highlight the vulnerability of even the most experienced pilots, as they face ruin and distress alongside the city's downfall, symbolized by their cries and the shaking suburbs. Ultimately, the pilots, along with mariners and all who navigate the sea, are brought to stand upon the land, signifying a humbling end to their former dominion.
